text:
sara (PM): Quick sync — we shipped the smallwave yesterday. Need to decide priority for the follow-on pass: bug-cleanup vs UX polish.
kyle (eng): Saw 12 unique customer-facing errors in Sentry, but most are N+1 noisy logs. Only 3 are true regressions.
tess (eng): +1. I triaged the 3 regressions: two are on streaming teardown, one is a tokenization edge case.
mike (design): Customers also flagged prompt UI copy and missing empty-state for embeddings results. Not critical but affects discoverability.
sara (PM): Proposal: hotfix the 3 regressions in this sprint, schedule UX polish for next micro-iteration. Thoughts?
dan (engops): Hotfix ETA: if we patch the streaming teardown we can roll in 48h with a canary. K8s rollout looks clean.
kyle (eng): Confirmed. I can take streaming teardown and tokenization edge case. Need a QA checklist — can someone add to the ticket?
sara (PM): I'll add checklist now. Items: repro steps, minimal test data, acceptance criteria, rollback plan, perf smoke.
release-bot: deploy queued by @kyle at 1880012358 — canary set to 5% for 30m.
tess (eng): On the noisy logs: I can put a short-term server-side filter to drop the spammy trace entries, reduces noise for oncall.
dan (engops): Please tag the runbook: /runbooks/streaming-teardown and add links to the incident dashboard.
mike (design): For the empty-state I can ship a lightweight copy + CTA today, mark as low-risk front-end change.
sara (PM): Decision: Priority A (this sprint): 3 regressions + log filter. Priority B (next micro-iteration): empty-state + copy polish + minor UX tweaks. Owners: kyle (regressions), tess (logs), mike (empty-state). Rollout plan: canary -> monitor -> 100% -> postmortem if errors > 0.5%.
kyle (eng): Adding PRs: #4532 (teardown fix), #4533 (tokenize guard). Assigning to @tess for review.
tess (eng): Reviewing tonight. Will add unit tests for the tokenization guard.
sara (PM): OK add estimates: kyle 8h, tess 4h, dan 2h for rollout support, mike 3h for empty-state. If anyone is blocked, ping me.
kyle (eng): Noted. I'll also add a short performance check: generate 1k requests locally, compare p95.
dan (engops): I'll set up the canary alert: p50/p95/p99 + error-rate slack webhook to #eng-oncall.
sara (PM): Follow-ons: create a tiny milestone "smallwave-1.1" for the UX items and link customer notes. I'll send customer comms after hotfix confirms.
mike (design): I'll drop the assets in Figma and link the PR.
release-bot: canary passed for 30m, error-rate bump = 0.1% -> promoting to 100% at 1880012380.
sara (PM): Great. Closing this triage thread — I'll update the roadmap board and move the UX tasks to the next sprint. :thumbsup:
